decision: Test whether the candidate tree and first-action extraction support beneficial lookahead when the sequence evaluator is correct. Evaluate the same full-GAR checkpoint and paired validation puzzles with three increasingly privileged terminal criteria: predicted latent distance to an encoded oracle goal, exact-transition encoded distance to that goal, and exact symbolic remaining-step distance. Sweep depth 1, 2, and 4 and narrow versus wide continuation budgets. If exact remaining distance improves or remains optimal with depth while learned goal distance degrades, sequence evaluation rather than root extraction is the failure. If exact distance also degrades, candidate sampling or tie handling is responsible.

jobs.purpose: Closed-loop oracle-distance controls separating candidate-tree validity, learned representation geometry, latent rollout drift, and terminal score quality. Depth above one uses the labeled candidate-privileged future feasible-action tree.
